notes.title: Strange Antiquities is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Strange Antiquities is out now![/b][/h2][p]Our release has finally arrived: [b]the doors to Strange Antiquities are now open![/b]
[/p][p]You can watch our brand-new launch trailer below: 

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/x5SmaoTT8r8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]After several years of tinkering, puzzling, and more than a few nights spent burning the candle at both ends, we are thrilled to welcome you back to Undermere. If this is your first visit, don’t worry: no prior knowledge is required.[/p][p]Step into your [b]new role as apprentice Thaumaturge, running an occult curiosity shop[/b] that is cosy, mysterious, and full of secrets waiting to be discovered.[/p][p]To celebrate our return to Undermere, we’re launching with a [b]10% discount[/b] [b]for the first week.[/b]
[/p][p][b]Share your thoughts[/b][/p][p]We’re just two brothers making these strange little games, and your feedback means a lot to us.  If you’ve already spent some time in the shop, [b][u]please consider leaving us a review![/u][/b] It’s one of the [b]best ways to support small indie teams[/b]. Reviews not only help us understand how you’re finding the game, they also help new players to discover it.
[/p][p][b]Join the community[/b][/p][p]If you encounter any bugs or major hiccups, feel free to [b]report them in our Steam Forums[/b]. If you want to swap notes with fellow Thaumaturges, share your theories, or just chat about how best to arrange your shelves, you can hop on the [url="https://discord.gg/xtCjxWFBv2"]Iceberg Interactive Discord[/url].
[/p][p][b]Thank You[/b][/p][p]It’s been a wonderful journey, and we want to thank you for your support. We’ve poured everything we have into Strange Antiquities, and seeing players step into the shop at last feels amazing.[/p][p][/p][p]The ravens are circling, Jupiter the cat is waiting for pets, and the bell won’t ding itself…
[/p][p][b][i]Welcome to Strange Antiquities.[/i][/b]
[/p][p]Rob & John[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031160/6cfd5bd4429ebb199a422e90c4891d3b92581cc7.png"][/img]--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   [b]Bad Viking[/b] [/p][list][*][p][url="https://twitter.com/BadVikingGames"]Twitter[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/badvikinggames.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/BadVikingGames"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/xtCjxWFBv2"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Iceberg Interactive[/b] [/p][list][*][p]  [url="http://www.twitter.com/iceberg_int"]Twitter[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@iceberg_int"]TikTok[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.facebook.com/iceberginteractive"]Facebook[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://www.youtube.com/iceberginteractive"]YouTube[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]  [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/iceberg"]Steam Publisher Page[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]

notes.title: The Thaumaturge’s Handbook: An FAQ for Strange Antiquities
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear Thaumaturges,[/b]
[/h3][p][/p][p]Before you set foot on the creaky floorboards of our shop on Hollowell Lane, we figured some of you still might have [b]a few questions about your role, the shop, and the journey ahead[/b]. In this blog, we’ll answer a handful of them to make sure you don’t cause someone’s demise during your very first shift.
[/p][p][b]Do I need to have played Strange Horticulture?[/b][/p][p]No. [i]Strange Antiquities[/i] is a [b]stand-alone sequel set in the same world but tells a completely separate story[/b]. Returning players will find [b]familiar mechanics and lore[/b], but the game has been designed to be welcoming for new players too. Take your time - discovery is part of the experience. And if you’re ever stuck, there’s a [b]hint button[/b] to help.
[/p][p][b]Will there be some familiar faces?[/b][/p][p]Yes. Previous visitors to Undermere may spot some [b]familiar customers, along with crossover lore, references, and Easter Eggs[/b] for fans of [i]Strange Horticulture[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Will there be multiple endings again?[/b][/p][p]Yes! There are at least [b]8 distinct endings[/b] to discover. None of them are “wrong” - they’re simply reflections of the path you took.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What about the Closer Inspect system?[/b][/p][p]We’ve expanded the “Closer Inspect” mechanic so you can now [b]examine items in greater detail[/b]. There are four categories of analysis, and you can hover your mouse over different sections of each artefact to uncover useful information and hidden clues.[/p][p][/p][p][b]… and the new books?[/b][/p][p]You’ll find [b]several new tomes to study[/b], packed with hints and lore to help identify strange antiquities.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What else is new?[/b][/p][p]Err. [u][b]No more spoilers now[/b][/u] - you’ll have to play the game and discover the game’s secrets for yourself. [/p][p][/p][p][b]I need to know: can you still pet the cat?[/b][/p][p]Of course. His name is [b]Jupiter[/b]. [i]To be honest, if regular petting is not part of your daily ritual, then one might infer that you’re a monster.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Eli White told me not to touch anything. I’m sure that means there are no secrets to discover, right?[/b][/p][p]Let's just say rules were meant to be broken... 😉 [/p][p][/p][p][b]What are the controls?[/b][/p][p]The game is fully playable with just a mouse.[/p][p]Right-click to inspect.[/p][p]Mouse wheel for magnifying glass. 
[/p][p]There are also keyboard shortcuts for those with a different play style.[/p][p]Arrow keys/WASD to move around the shop.[/p][p]Shift for magnifying glass[/p][p][/p][p][b]Is there controller support?[/b][/p][p]Yes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Does it play well on Steam Deck?[/b][/p][p]Yes. Tested, tuned, and [b]Verified[/b] on Steam Deck![/p][p][/p][p][b]How long is the game?[/b][/p][p]Tricky to say. [b]6-10 hours, but possibly longer[/b], depending on how you play. [/p][p][/p][p][b]What is the price point?[/b][/p][p]$17.99 with a 10% launch discount[/p][p][/p][p][b]What engine does it run on?[/b][/p][p]Unity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Do you plan to release it on additional platforms?[/b][/p][p]PC and Nintendo Switch at launch. More platforms to follow in due course.
[/p][p][b]What about Mac?[/b][/p][p]Mac is a [b]priority[/b] for us, but we couldn’t get it ready in time for launch. Please bear with us - we’ll update you as soon as we can…[/p][p][/p][p][b]What are the accessibility options?[/b][/p][list][*][p]Easy-to-read [b]fonts[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Zoom with the [b]Magnifying Glass[/b] [/p][/*][*][p]“Closer Inspect” descriptions include [b]colour cues[/b] - we’re colourblind ourselves, and we’ve tried to make sure fellow colour-impaired folk can play comfortably. [/p][/*][*][p]Mouse-only controls, but with added keyboard support.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arachnophia setting[/b] - there’s a small spider who sometimes wanders around the clock. His name is Tony. He’s harmless… but you can toggle him off if you’d prefer not to see him.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]What languages is the game in?[/b][/p][p]At launch: [b]English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian.[/b]
[/p][p][b]I want to cover the game on my channel/blog/outlet. How do I get a key?[/b][/p][p]For any coverage inquiries, just send an email to [u][i][b]pr\[at]iceberg-games\[dot]com[/b][/i][/u]! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Where do I report bugs if I find one?[/b][/p][p]You can report any bugs and hiccups [b]in our Steam forum[/b]. We’ll set up a dedicated bug-reproting thread here. 

[b]I uncovered some haunted antiquities in my grandpa’s attic. What do I do?[/b][/p][p]Apprentice at Strange Antiquities, and you’ll soon learn that every object has its uses… and its dangers.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031160/6cfd5bd4429ebb199a422e90c4891d3b92581cc7.png"][/img]

notes.title: Undermere Herald - January Edition | A Brand-New Town Map
notes.content:
[h3]Dear readers,[/h3]

Welcome to this year’s very first edition of the Undermere Herald – [b]the most trustworthy news source for Undermere and its surroundings.[/b]

And that’s exactly what our industrious writers will be focussing on this month! The key to not getting lost in the narrow and winding lanes of our beautiful town is [b]a good & accurate map. [/b]

[b]Picture this: [/b]
[list]
[*] You are visiting Undermere for the first time and, in an attempt to see the sights, you want to venture from the [b]History Museum[/b] to the [b]Pier [/b]to pay a visit to the [b]Bleak Stones on Naylor Island. [/b]
[*]Or, maybe you’re a resident and you just uncovered a mysterious object in your attic that you’d like to [b]get appraised at Strange Antiquities.[/b] [/list]
Well, fret not! The local council of Undermere has just released a brand-new town map, listing all key locations in the town – including landmarks, public buildings, and businesses. Unlike the council’s previous maps, [b]this one exclusively focuses on the town of Undermere rather than the surrounding area![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031160/085bdea105b841f5c4831d5025ef721ead1ad455.png[/img]

The Undermere Town Map is a great addition to anyone’s map collection, making interacting with the town easier for residents and visitors alike. 

Finally, you will be able to [b]explore every inch of Undermere[/b] and discover your own story, without the fear of getting lost in its charming labyrinth of streets. If maps are your thing, then stay tuned - [b]we've got more than just a town map hidden up our sleeves![/b]

The Undermere Town Map is available for free at various locations throughout the town.

notes.title: A First Look at Strange Antiquities’ Refined Gameplay!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Thaumaturges,[/h3]

Remember that [url=https://youtu.be/JlHujFwR8KQ]teaser [/url]from a while ago?

Well, today [b]we’re incredibly excited to finally give you a more detailed glimpse into the wonderful world of Strange Antiquities[/b]. A few weeks ago, we got together in an old candle-lit cottage and tried to recreate some of the atmosphere from the game – [i]rustic shelves, old maps, and as many strange-looking antiques as we could find[/i] – [b]to film an exclusive, first look trailer![/b] 

[previewyoutube=5YravLrvr6o;full][/previewyoutube]

In this gameplay trailer, you’ll get[b] a first in-depth look at some of the mechanics in Strange Antiquities[/b]. We’ll take you through the updated [i]Closer Inspect[/i] system that allows you to examine items in more detail, as well as the Thaumaturge's library of esoteric tomes.

For this sequel, we wanted to [b]take the identity of Strange Horticulture, while building on the parts we all love and bringing more depth to the gameplay and detective work[/b]. It’ll still feel like Undermere with its cosy rain-soaked atmosphere and darkly mysterious undercurrent – but with new challenges, new puzzles, and new approaches. [b]What new feature are you most excited about?[/b]

We can’t wait to show you more in the future,

John & Rob

notes.title: Strange things are happening in Undermere…
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031160/6427c433406768a58e06989056775d8c6aa4df9c.gif[/img]

Taking place several years after the events of Strange Horticulture, [b]Strange Antiquities is a new, dark, and cosy standalone adventure[/b] set in the world of Undermere. It is a place of ancient woodland, candle-lit libraries, and macabre folklore, where strange things happen as often as it rains.

You are the Thaumaturge’s apprentice, tasked with running a shop dealing in occult antiquities. When hundreds of ravens start circling over the town of Undermere, those in the know become concerned. Occult Scholar Verona Green visits Strange Antiquities to enquire about the unnatural series of events. But before she is able to meet with the Thaumaturge, [i]events take a sinister turn…[/i]

[h5]Check out the teaser trailer for a sneak peek of what awaits:[/h5]
[previewyoutube=Ma1lDaPi82U;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45031160/157ba460d5c18c5930f7fd665d41ea747a843137.png[/img]
We are two brothers from the UK who have been making games together for over a decade. In 2022 we released our occult puzzle game Strange Horticulture, and the response has been incredible; from amazing reviews and award nominations to appearing in numerous best-of-the-year lists. Most importantly, [b]it has been a joy to read the kind words left by so many of our players on Steam[/b], where we are still rated Overwhelmingly Positive after almost 10,000 reviews!

[b]We want to thank everyone who has played Strange Horticulture, left us a review, told their friends, or supported the game in any way.[/b] It has been an amazing journey and we can't wait to share the next chapter with you.

Please wishlist and follow Strange Antiquities here to stay up-to-date with the development and help us spread the word.

[h3][b]Many thanks,[/b][/h3]
[h5]Rob & John[/h5]
